reason: A DSH integration adapter that receives Satori messaging events over WebSocket and sends agent text replies through the Satori HTTP API, with configurable access controls and inbound image handling.

summaries.zh: 通过 Satori WebSocket 接收消息事件，并通过其 HTTP API 将 DSH Agent 的文本回复发送回私聊或群聊。
summaries.en: Receives Satori messaging events over WebSocket and sends DSH agent text replies back to private or group chats through the Satori HTTP API.

capabilities: Sends text replies through the Satori HTTP API
Uses a configured access-token credential reference
Downloads supported inbound images and stores them as DSH attachment references
Maintains or restores DSH session persistence
